_comment: Distribution-repo suite: this repo ships the standard, it isn't a buildable app. project_type=docs narrows the run to the rules that fit a docs/distribution repo (build/test/service rules produce no row). Scored via: node check.mjs --repo .
_baseline_rules: The BASELINE RULES LAYER: every rule outside the trust circle (BUILD-03, BUILD-04, GOV-03, SEC-01, SEC-02), opted in or out as one layer at setup time. Default is IN, so an ABSENT key gates — this repo states it explicitly to keep the choice visible, and `true` and no key at all are the same run. `false` makes those rules resolve n/a: no finding, excluded from the exit gate, and the layer's state printed on every check. `baseline trust setup --baseline-rules in|out` is what writes it.
_sources_of_truth: PROSE IS NOT AN AUTHORITY HERE — code is. Every entry below is a file a script executes or a machine reads. The prose under docs/ is deliberately absent: it is a VIEW of these files, and where a doc and this list disagree, this list wins. Documentary since the v4 cut: no rule reads this key.

sources_of_truth.check.mjs: The runner — the single authority on how a rule is scored. Read it, do not read about it.
sources_of_truth.rules.json: The rule-set manifest (version, module list); the rules themselves live in rules/*.json, canonical and machine-readable — node check.mjs --self-check prints how many, so no file has to say.
sources_of_truth.rules/: The rule set. A rule's own title, lesson, rationale and fix ship here; docs/REFERENCE.md renders them and can never add to them.
sources_of_truth.src/evaluators.mjs: The closed set of check kinds — what a rule is allowed to ask about a repo.
sources_of_truth.src/trust.mjs: The trust circle: the roster, each member's integrity tier, and the stamp format CI reads.
sources_of_truth.test/red/: The invariants. Where this repo's prose and a red test disagree, the test wins and the prose is wrong.
